phase_policies.applies_when: Early game around 3 minutes with heavy economy and tech investment, army composition unclear; enemy shows Reaper or Marine indicating possible early harassment or push.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when more information about enemy army composition and intentions is available.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech, build defensive structures/units, strengthen ground forces, maintain expansion.
phase_policies.target: Develop economy and technology while strengthening ground forces and preparing defense against early pressure.
phase_policies.title: Early Tech-Economy Development with Defensive Preparation
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to tech and economy without ensuring defensive capability against early harassment.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 6 minutes with heavy economy and production, ground units like Stalkers; enemy shows ground posture with Marines and Reapers, heavy tech investment.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if enemy shows signs of air transitions or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground forces, increase production and tech, maintain economy and expansion, keep defense in mind.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and increasing production and technology while maintaining economy and expansion pace.
phase_policies.title: Early-Mid Ground Tech Consolidation
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect defense while expanding economy and production.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 9 minutes with heavy ground army including Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, Warp Prisms; enemy shows ground posture with Marines, Reapers, Marauders, Medivacs indicating bio-based army.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if enemy adds air units or shows signs of a tech switch.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground forces, increase production, maintain economy and expansion, add tech units as needed.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and increasing production; consider adding tech units like Immortals or Colossi to counter bio army.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army Consolidation with Tech Additions
phase_policies.veto: Do not ignore upgrades and positioning while focusing on production and tech.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 10 minutes with heavy ground army including High Templars and Sentries; enemy shows ground posture with Marines, Reapers, Marauders, Medivacs and heavy defense.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if enemy shows air units or a tech switch.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Increase production and tech, add complementary units, maintain economy and expansion, keep upgrades on par.
phase_policies.target: Continue increasing production and technology, consider adding Colossi or Archons to complement High Templars; maintain economy and expansion.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Tech and Army Expansion
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect upgrades and army positioning while teching up.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
